value: battery-electric underground mobile fleet (drilling, blasting, bolting, ore haulage) as at Goldcorp's Borden gold mine, Chapleau, Ontario - Canada's first fully electric underground mine; also cuts ventilation demand. Electric equipment costs 25-30% more upfront than diesel equivalents, with comparable or favourable lifecycle cost

note: in operation at Borden; limited by the availability of large-capacity electric haul trucks and needs reliable grid access
Borden: about 7,000 t CO2/yr avoided by removing ~2 ML/yr of diesel and 1 ML/yr of propane; ventilation savings 33,000 MWh/yr, about USD 9 million/yr opex saving
